package.name: human_detector
package.description:
SAN v1.5.1 PHASE 6 - AI inference backend abstraction + full pipeline node (camera sub -> NPU infer -> DetectionArray pub). Backends: RK3588 NPU (librknnrt + YOLOv5 post-process), Hailo-8 M.2, stub. Detector node selects backend via yaml and auto-falls-back when the requested SDK is absent.
DCN-2026-003 D-003 (2026-05-13): C++ wiring complete — replaces the Python san_perception path on RK3588 hardware. Airys V6.13.5 RKNN + YOLOv5 reference implementation ported to ROS 2.
